title: Joining the Owls at the end of their run
summary: He and Eddie Miller joined the Owls near the end; personnel, drummer Johnny Brent, and the failed Spanish Fort engagement.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Was Pinky with the Owls later or before?
No he had been, wait now, no later he was with the Owls, because I joined the Owls just before they broke up at the very end. Oh is that right? Eddie Miller and I played with the Owls.
Who was in the Owls when you joined?
Dan LeBlanc and Frank Netto. And Frank had changed to bass and Julian Lane played trombone and what's his name now? Trumpet player.
Padron.

Bill Padron. And Dan LeBlanc played third alto. He had moved from bass to third alto. And Ormond Hug played piano. And I'm trying to remember the drummer. I can officialize him but I can't remember his name.
Is that the guy that's in some kind of carnival business today where he does decorations? Was this the guy that came in after Earl Crum?
That was after Earl Crum, yeah.
That'll come to you.
Johnny Brent. Oh yeah. He's moved to California some years ago.
Yeah he played with Turkin Murphy for a while. Did he?
I didn't know that.
Yeah he's on some record with Turkin Murphy. I was surprised to see that.
He's a nice drummer. Johnny played good.
Very good drummer. Was he a New Orleanian originally?
No he's from Shreveport, around that section. Yeah he's from around, Jeff Riddick and he I believe was from the same hometown. I think Shreveport.
Let's see, did we get a guitar player with the Owls?

Yeah, Angelo Palmasana for a guitar. He never did join a union. He just faded out and quit playing gradually and then all the rest of us, I believe we were in the union at the time or just before we joined the union. We played at the old Spanish fort, the opening of the new pavilion, on percentage, commission basis. And the first week we worked we got sixty cents a piece. Good Lord.
Good Lord.

But I think we made more than that but we just didn't get it. One of those things you know. So we tried it for two weeks and it didn't pay so we just quit. And from then on the Owls broke up after that. The individuals went on different jobs.
